text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 4px focus ring with a 2px offset on every interactive element that gets keyboard focus. This width balances visibility for low-vision users with minimal layout shift for others. The 2px offset keeps the ring from touching adjacent elements, avoiding overlap issues. Trade-off: slightly thicker than some standards, but necessary for EXCAVA’s small touch targets.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 4px ring with 2px offset fails 4.5:1 contrast on dark gray (#111) at 125% zoom. Switch to a 3px ring with 3px offset—it meets 4.5:1 on dark gray and still avoids overlap. Test with Playwright MCP to confirm.
